note: Where each hung council is leaning before its mayoral vote, based on news reports. lean: -2 likely A, -1 lean A, 0 toss-up, 1 lean B, 2 likely B. Bloc seats are counted from the council results.

JHB.why: Daily Maverick reports the ANC, ActionSA, MK and EFF will form the core of Johannesburg’s government, with Herman Mashaba likely to be inaugurated this week. EWN says parties are in the final stages of talks and the mayor is now expected to be elected on Friday. The deal is still to be signed.
src: Coalition negotiations: new Joburg mayor now expected to be elected Friday
ANC, ActionSA, MK and EFF seal metro pact
Political week ahead: deadline to form municipalities draws closer

TSH.why: Under the four-party arrangement reported by Daily Maverick and Business Day, ActionSA’s Nasiphi Moya keeps the Tshwane mayoralty. The council sits on Thursday, EWN reports; the deal is still to be signed.
src: Political week ahead: deadline to form municipalities draws closer
ANC, ActionSA, MK and EFF seal metro pact
Coalition negotiations: new Joburg mayor now expected to be elected Friday

EKU.why: Business Day reports the ANC is expected to take Ekurhuleni’s mayoralty under its deal with ActionSA, the EFF and MK, and Daily Maverick says the four parties will govern the metro. The council sits on Wednesday, EWN reports.
src: Political week ahead: deadline to form municipalities draws closer
ANC, ActionSA, MK and EFF seal metro pact
Coalition negotiations: new Joburg mayor now expected to be elected Friday

ETH.why: IOL reports the ANC and MK have sealed an eThekwini deal, with a source saying MK takes the mayoralty, ActionSA the deputy mayor post and the ANC the speaker. Despite a KZN Cogta order to postpone, the city says its first council meeting goes ahead on Tuesday, EWN reports.
src: eThekwini to go ahead with inaugural council meeting despite KZN Cogta directive
MK Party tipped for eThekwini mayor as coalition talks near conclusion
ANC and MK Party seal eThekwini coalition deal as ActionSA’s future hangs in balance

NMA.why: IOL reports the DA, ActionSA, UDM and FF Plus are in advanced talks, with the DA’s Andrew Whitfield confident of a stable coalition. Analysts say the DA holds the upper hand, and ActionSA says it will back the DA’s mayoral candidate. No deal has been reported as signed.
src: Nelson Mandela Bay: DA-ActionSA-UDM-FF Plus in advanced coalition stages
ActionSA says it doesn’t have a problem working with DA
DA Eastern Cape ‘very pleased’ as Nelson Mandela Bay coalition deal nears finish line

BUF.why: News24 reports the ANC is close to a deal with the EFF and SACP, while the UDM courts a wider bloc of its own.
src: UDM courts wider coalition bloc in Buffalo City, as ANC nears deal with EFF, SACP

MAN.why: The ANC and DA are one seat apart, and no deal has been reported yet.
src: ANC loses outright control of Mangaung for the first time as DA nips at its heels
